I've extracted and created the following React components from the SVGs in the MastraHomepageHero component:

1. `CloudInterfaceSVG.tsx` - The cloud interface SVG from the first card
2. `DevelopmentInterfaceSVG.tsx` - The development interface SVG from the third card
3. `TerminalWindowSVG.tsx` - The terminal window SVG from the third card

Each SVG has been properly formatted as a React component with TypeScript types. I've also created an `index.ts` file to make importing these components easier.

You can now import and use these SVG components in your React application like this:

```tsx
import { CloudInterfaceSVG, DevelopmentInterfaceSVG, TerminalWindowSVG } from './components/svgs';

// Then use them in your components
<CloudInterfaceSVG />
<DevelopmentInterfaceSVG />
<TerminalWindowSVG />
```

All SVG components maintain their original attributes, classes, and styling.
